cand.title: RE+ Mexico 2027
cand.excerpt: Strong event evidence and clear Guadalajara demand mechanism; accessibility is discounted where the venue or incumbent hotel is confirmed.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Samuel Ramírez, Director of RE+ MEXICO and ECOMONDO MEXICO at IGECO, is the primary commercial routing contact. Damián Arias, IGECO Director of Operations, is a second operational routing contact; the 2026 handbook publishes his event operations email. Neither is verified as the hotel-contract signatory or accommodation budget owner. Additional published regional event-sales contacts are listed separately.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed event activity dates: April 20–22, 2027, Expo Guadalajara. The registration page gives visiting hours April 20–21, 11:00–18:00, and April 22, 11:00–17:00. The official 2027 factsheet independently corroborates dates and venue. This is within the requested horizon; these are not publication dates. A third-party 2028 listing says dates TBD; no organizer-confirmed 2028 dates were established.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference: Sheraton Guadalajara Expo is a strong city-hotel lodging and ancillary-meeting fit, not a resort-led venue pitch. Marriott places it minutes from Expo Guadalajara and Plaza del Sol and advertises guestrooms, catering and event-planning assistance; its meetings page lists 12 event rooms and a largest-space capacity of 500. Target exhibitor teams, international visitors, speakers and organizer staff for guestrooms and optional client meetings/dinners, not relocation of the exhibition. The supplied 216-room inventory is not event demand, and no room-night forecast is justified.
findings.venueCommitments: Expo Guadalajara is the publicly announced 2027 venue, not a competing hotel. Public venue designation is verified; a signed venue contract was not inspected. Historical hotel-rate relationships do not establish 2027 room-block commitments.
findings.historicalRotation: Predecessor Solar Power Mexico was advertised in Mexico City in 2019 and 2021, then León in 2022. Solar + Storage Mexico used Expo Guadalajara in 2023–2024; RE+ Mexico used Expo Guadalajara in 2025–2026 and is announced there for 2027. The 2022 organizer directory documents the change to Solar + Storage for 2023; the venue and 2024 report document evolution to RE+. This is a recurring series with historical destination changes, not evidence of a currently open host-city rotation. The postponed 2020 announcement is not proof that edition occurred.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Hotel sourcing status: UNKNOWN / hotel_sourcing_unconfirmed for 2027. The official hotel page offers preferred rates, hotel emails, reservation codes and direct booking links; numerous codes explicitly say 2026. The 2026 exhibitor handbook directs exhibitors to that page and an event code. This supports an organizer-promoted, hotel-direct booking pathway, but does not prove guaranteed blocks, room commitments, exclusivity, a housing RFP, or 2027 availability. No separately appointed housing agency/PCO was identified.
findings.organizationStructure: Commercial exhibition rather than an association congress. Italian German Exhibition Company Mexico (IGECO) is identified as the organizing committee/operator in the 2026 handbook; exhibitor payments are payable to Italian German Exhibition Company México S.A. de C.V. This historical exhibitor contracting evidence does not establish the 2027 hotel contracting entity. Organizer materials document RE+ Events and SNEC as international partners. Expo Guadalajara is the venue, not the event owner or hotel buyer. No independent PCO/DMC appointment was established.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The published hotel roster includes The Westin Guadalajara, Barceló Guadalajara, IBIS Expo Guadalajara, Fiesta Inn Guadalajara Expo, AC Marriot Guadalajara Expo, RIU Plaza Guadalajara, Hotel Presidente InterContinental Guadalajara, One Guadalajara Expo, City Express Plus, Holiday Inn Guadalajara Expo, Holiday Inn Guadalajara Select, Wyndham Garden and Hampton by Hilton. These are published preferred-rate alternatives, predominantly evidenced by 2026 codes, not verified 2027 block holders. Westin and Barceló are shown as one-minute walks. Sheraton is absent from the reviewed list. No sourced sell-out, overflow requirement, exclusive housing agreement or competitor pickup figures were found.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Approach Samuel Ramírez at samuel.ramirez@igeco.mx and ask to include Damián Arias at damian.arias@igeco.mx. Ask who owns 2027 hotel partnerships, whether the online 2026-coded hotel list has been renewed, whether additional hotels can join, and whether any rooms are centrally purchased or all bookings are individual. Offer an Expo-proximity guestrooms plus small-meeting/catering proposal only after checking hotel availability and organizer requirements. Request actual room-night history, peak rooms, staff/speaker requirements, release dates and next-cycle review timing. Do not promise inventory or describe the lead as an RFP.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: As of November 14, 2026, the next confirmed edition is April 2027. Exhibition venue selection is already announced, so do not sell the main-event venue. Accommodation access remains unconfirmed: historical preferred-rate competitors reduce confidence in immediate official-list capture, but do not prove it closed. Qualification outreach and direct exhibitor account development are reasonable; a 2027 block or overflow opportunity is not verified.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: repeated Guadalajara editions and the organizer-promoted hotel-rate pathway support a repeat-account strategy. Seek 2027 preferred-hotel inclusion if the organizer confirms it is still possible; otherwise request the next hotel-partner review timetable. Maintain future-cycle relationship development without treating the third-party 2028 TBD listing as a confirmed edition within May 2028.
